title: Headshots Retoucher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Headshots Retoucher em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Headshots.com is transforming how professional headshots are delivered. Trusted by enterprise clients such as Boeing, Netflix, and American Express, we produce studio-quality headshots from smartphone images—backed by world-class production and technology.

Our retouching team is critical to delivering consistent, natural, high-quality results at scale. We are hiring experienced headshot retouchers for ongoing work who can handle high volume while maintaining realism, accuracy, and professional polish.

Role Overview

This role focuses on high-quality retouching of professional headshots sourced from mobile phone photos. You will work within established production standards to deliver natural, realistic results—preserving skin texture, correcting lighting issues, and ensuring consistency across batches.

Following a brief unpaid test project, selected candidates will invited for an interview, with the opportunity for long-term, steady work.

Core Responsibilities

Image Retouching & Quality Control

  • Retouch professional headshots from phone photos with a natural, realistic finish
  • Correct skin tone, noise, mixed lighting, exposure issues, and soft focus
  • Reduce or remove glasses glare while preserving realism
  • Perform background swaps and composites that look seamless and believable
  • Maintain consistency and quality across large batches of images

Production & Workflow Discipline

  • Deliver work on time and meet daily/weekly volume expectations
  • Follow established retouching guidelines and quality standards
  • Apply feedback consistently and efficiently
  • Communicate clearly if issues arise that could affect timelines or quality

Core Skills Required

  • Natural skin retouching (texture preserved; no plastic or over-processed look)
  • Clean hair masking and edge work (no halos)
  • Realistic background compositing
  • Strong color correction and exposure balancing, especially in uneven or mixed light
  • Excellent time management and consistency at scale
  • Strong written English (spoken English for occasional Zoom calls is a plus)

Hardware & Software Requirements (Must-Have)

  • Graphics tablet (Wacom, Huion, XP-Pen, or similar)
  • Legitimate Adobe Photoshop subscription (no cracked software)
  • MacBook Pro Retina or equivalent high-quality PC laptop display
  • Monitor accurate in sRGB (DCI-P3 support is a plus)

Volume, Timing & Pay

  • Expected volume after trial period: 100+ images/month, with potential to scale higher
  • The $2,000/month reference rate is based on completing approximately 20 headshots per day across 20 working days

Application Requirements (Read Carefully)

Apply by completing the test project:

Hiring Process

  • Applicants are asked to complete a brief unpaid test project
  • Successful test submissions will be invited to interview
  • Ongoing, consistent work available for high-performing retouchers
  • Direct inquiries will disqualify candidates. All applications must be submitted through Indeed.
  • Job Types: Full-time, Contract

IMPORTANT

All candidates must apply via LinkedIn. Direct contact with Headshots.com regarding this position will not be considered and may result in disqualification from the process.

Experience: Typically in enterprise software or technical program management.

Getmereferred.Com

Strong understanding of the TPM lifecycle: planning, budgeting, execution, and analytics.

Certifications in Salesforce (Admin, Platform App Builder) are often mandatory for these specialist roles.

title: Customer Onboarding Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Onboarding Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.

We're expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Onboarding Specialist. You will own the customers' first 30 - 45 days, set the tone for the relationship, build confidence and ensure customers are ready quickly and correctly. This role defines the customer's first impression of Smarter Contact and has clear growth potential within a fast-scaling SaaS company. This is a direct-hire role.

What You'll Own:

  • Lead and follow up on all 1-1 or group onboarding sessions via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Guide customers through initial setup, configuration, and first live campaigns
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact's value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Ensure customers reach defined activation milestones within the onboarding window
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or risk during onboarding-escalate and resolve
  • Document onboarding outcomes, next steps, and handoff notes clearly in CRM
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience to ensure a clean transition post onboarding.
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time, Monday to Friday

What We're Looking For:

  • 4+ years in Customer Success, Onboarding or Implementation at a SaaS company
  • Experience with US-based customers
  • Excellent communication and conversational skills, both written and verbal
  • Proficient or native level English (full business fluency)
  • Detail-oriented, process-driven, and highly organized
  • Engaging, personable, and energetic in customer interactions
  • Comfortable working at high volume without losing quality
  • Sales-trained and able to identify business expansion opportunities
  • Coachable, performance-driven, accountable, and a strong team player,
  • Proven track record of meeting and/or exceeding a business expansion quota

Bonus Points:

  • Experience working at a telecom SaaS
  • Experience working with real estate agents or using real estate SaaS tools

️ Why Smarter Contact?

  • USD base compensation
  • 15 days PTO + 5 sick days + 10 floating holidays
  • High autonomy, fast execution, real impact
  • Professional development benefit
  • Wellness benefit
  • Employment anniversary and birthday gift
  • Quarterly health allowance
  • Remote-first team with a strong performance culture
  • This opportunity is offered as a full-time independent contractor role

Please Don't Apply If:

  • You prefer a low-pressure, low-output environment
  • You're not fluent in English or are uncomfortable communicating directly with cross-functional teams
  • You don't meet the minimum customer success experience
  • No experience working for a SaaS company

Ready to grow with us?

We're looking for a proven Customer Onboarding Specialist ready to build the next chapter of their career — and stay for the long haul. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Loyalty Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you'll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.

  • Proven ability to analyze customer behavior, identify churn risks, and take targeted action to retain accounts.
  • Strong objection handling, negotiation, and behavioral communication skills with the ability to influence customer decisions under pressure.
  • Ability to diagnose and act on different churn drivers (budget, usage, performance, lifecycle, compliance) with tailored retention strategies.
  • Able to work efficiently in a high-activity environment without sacrificing quality.
  • Comfortable holding long-format video calls for reviewing customer accounts and demonstrating product value.
  • Coachable, performance-driven, accountable, and a strong team player.
  • Proficient or native level English (full business fluency).
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 am and 7 pm EST, Monday to Friday.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience working at a CPaaS or Martech SaaS company.
  • Experience working with real estate professionals.

title: Senior Business Analyst - Supply Chain
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Business Analyst - Supply Chain em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.

Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.

Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain, a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.

Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

- Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

- Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

- Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

- Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

- Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.

Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

- Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).

- Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.

- Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.

- Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.

- Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.

- Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.

- Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.

- Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.

Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)

- Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.

- Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

- Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

- Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.

Must Have

- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

- Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).

- Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.

- Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).

- Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.

- Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

- Experience with project management and collaboration tools.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

- Availability to travel.

- Legally authorized to work in Brazil.

What We Offer

- Competitive salary and benefits package.

- Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

- A collaborative and international work environment.

- Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.

Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Engenheiro De Dados Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro De Dados Sênior em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Volpi

Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário. Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais. Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!

O desafio

Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.

Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.

Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership, tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi, com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
  • Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
  • Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance;
  • Lidar com dadosdistribuídos em múltiplos silos, conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
  • Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
  • Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
  • Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros, incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
  • Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida como Data Engineer, com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
  • Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
  • Experiência prática com AWS, especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
  • Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC);
  • Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
  • Forte preocupação com segurança da informação, padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Experiência em ambientes de startup, lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
  • Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;

title: Engenheiro De Dados Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro De Dados Sênior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Volpi

Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário. Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais. Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!

O desafio

Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.

Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.

Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership, tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi, com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
  • Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
  • Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance;
  • Lidar com dadosdistribuídos em múltiplos silos, conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
  • Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
  • Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
  • Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros, incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
  • Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida como Data Engineer, com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
  • Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
  • Experiência prática com AWS, especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
  • Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC);
  • Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
  • Forte preocupação com segurança da informação, padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Experiência em ambientes de startup, lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
  • Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
  • Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.

Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
  • Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
  • Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
  • Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.

  • Plano de saúde Alice (100% pago para titular e dependentes)

title: Analista De Implantação Erp - Módulo Fiscal/Contábil
description:

Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos. Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento. Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança. Eficácia:Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido. Entusiasmo:Acreditamos que o entusiasmo e a positividade são essenciais para o sucesso. Quem ama o que faz trabalha com alegria e aproveita a jornada. Evolução:Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação. Colaboração:Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.Estamos procurando profissionais dinâmicos e proativos, com uma atitude positiva e habilidades em negócios e sistemas para trabalho em equipe. Valorizamos paciência, comprometimento e a capacidade de lidar bem com usuários e clientes. Se você já tem experiência em implantação de sistemas, excelente! Caso contrário, oferecemos um ambiente onde você pode aprender constantemente. Fazer parte da nossa equipe exige dedicação e disposição para adquirir um profundo conhecimento sobre nosso sistema. Esta oportunidade inclui viagens para várias localidades do Brasil.Responsabilidades:Executar a implantação de sistemas, estando alocado ou não no cliente, ministrando treinamentos para gestores e colaboradores do cliente;
Ministrar treinamentos acerca das parametrizações e demais funcionalidades garantindo pleno conhecimento e satisfação do cliente;
Preparar documentação dos módulos correspondentes;
Realizar testes das funcionalidades considerando as regras de negócios do ERP;
Participar de reuniões,inclusive com o cliente, parceiros da Bluesoft e a equipe da Bluesoft;
Documentar os treinamentos e enviar relatório de atendimento que demonstre a evolução dos treinamentos ministrados e enviar às partes interessadas.Requisitos:Residir na Grande São Paulo;
Disponibilidade para viagens;
Importante:Na Bluesoft, cada consultor atua no módulo em que possui mais experiência e familiaridade. Ou seja, você não precisará dominar todos os módulos — vamos direcionar sua atuação com base no seu principal conhecimento. Conhecimento ou vivência no Comercial de redes varejistas, como comprador ou assistente de compras;
Experiência com Implantação de Sistemas/Consultor de ERP ou como Key User (usuário chave) de ERP;
Ensino Superior em Administração, Finanças, Ciências Contábeis ou cursos relacionados à Gestão e Negócios;
Experiência com Varejo;
Familiaridade com PDVs e arquivos de cupons fiscais;
Experiência no Comercial de redes varejistas, como comprador ou assistente de compras;
Visão analítica para apresentação de relatórios de BI com o objetivo de atender às necessidades do cliente;
Resiliência e capacidade de autoaprendizagem.

Sobre a vaga

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Missão:

Garantir a evolução contínua da arquitetura de TI da Dimensa, atuando de forma transversal nas BUs para padronizar tecnologias, impulsionar inovação e assegurar que os produtos atendam a requisitos de escalabilidade, elasticidade, segurança, performance e time-to-market. O arquiteto será responsável por criar frameworks, acelerar a produtividade, viabilizar novos produtos voltados a Dados e IA, apoiar os times de desenvolvimento e infraestrutura, promover a evolução tecnológica, apoiar a operação de sistemas críticos e representar a arquitetura nas frentes corporativas e junto aos clientes, alinhados à estratégia da arquitetura corporativa.

O Que Você Vai fazer (As Principais Entregas):

  • Apoiar as BUs com diretrizes arquiteturais, garantindo aderência e alinhamento estratégico
  • Atuar na construção e manutenção da nova plataforma de aceleração de sistemas
  • Pesquisar e avaliar novas tecnologias visando à evolução tecnológica dos produtos da empresa.
  • Elaborar e gerir documentos técnicos de decisão, como ADRs, RFCs e RFPs, para formalização de propostas e mudanças arquiteturais
  • Realizar governança técnica com foco em riscos, impactos e sustentabilidade das soluções
  • Propor melhorias e novos produtos com base em oportunidades tecnológicas, dados e IA
  • Representar a Arquitetura em fóruns corporativos e alinhar iniciativas estratégicas com as Business Units (BUs)
  • Definir processos relacionados à arquitetura corporativa e governança técnica

title: Senior Technical Consultant - Front Arena
description:

Why Zensar?

We're a bunch of hardworking, fun-loving, people-oriented technology enthusiasts. We love what we do, and we're passionate about helping our clients thrive in an increasingly complex digital world. Zensar is an organization focused on building relationships with our clients and with each other—and happiness is at the core of everything we do. In fact, we're so into happiness that we've created a Global Happiness Council, and we send out a Happiness Survey to our employees each year. We've learned that employee happiness requires more than a competitive paycheck, and our employee value proposition—grow, own, achieve, learn (GOAL)—lays out the core opportunities we seek to foster for every employee. Teamwork and collaboration are critical to Zensar's mission and success, and our teams work on a diverse and challenging mix of technologies across a broad industry spectrum. These industries include banking and financial services, high-tech and manufacturing, healthcare, insurance, retail, and consumer services. Our employees enjoy flexible work arrangements and a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), among other benefits. If you are looking for a place to have an immediate impact, to grow and contribute, where we work hard, play hard, and support each other, consider joining team Zensar!

Zensar is looking for a Senior Technical Consultant – Front Arena .

About the Role

The Senior Technical Consultant will act as the technical SME for the Front Arena implementation, responsible for overall technical design, integrations, and enabling delivery teams during both scoping and execution phases.

Key Responsibilities

Lead technical design for the Front Arena or Murex (MX.3B) or Calypso (Nasdaq) technical configuration (static data, environments) implementation

Own technical architecture, integrations, and system configuration approach

Support scoping activities, including defining technical complexity and risks

Act as technical SME to guide and upskill junior and partner consultants

Work closely with functional leads to ensure coherent front to back solutions

Support on site workshops as required

Required Skills & Experience

Spanish nice to have

Strong Front Arena technical expertise (configuration, architecture, integrations) or Murex (MX.3B) or Calypso (Nasdaq) technical configuration (static data, environments)

Experience with full front to back Front Arena implementations

Prior involvement in large scale / greenfield implementations

Ability to mentor and guide junior technical resources

Experience working in multi vendor delivery models

Spanish language skills strongly preferred

Experience in Latin American / Mexican market environments is a strong advantage,

Competent with Python

Zensar believes that diversity of backgrounds, thought, experience, and expertise fosters the robust exchange of ideas that enables the highest quality collaboration and work product. Este profissional atuará como referência técnica na definição de arquitetura, padrões e práticas de engenharia, conduzindo times na construção de soluções modernas baseadas em cloud, containers e práticas de DevOps/SRE. - Conhecimento em FinOps e otimização de custos em cloud

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Data Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.

Nosso Cliente

Você irá atuar em um projeto global do nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do setor de óleo e gás, assumindo um papel técnico-estratégico dedicado ao Azure DevOps (ADO) e às plataformas de dados.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Trabalhar com estruturas de dados de média a alta complexidade em ambiente corporativo.
  • Atuar de forma hands-on com SQL para manipulação e análise de dados.
  • Transformar dados utilizando Azure Data Factory (ADF), incluindo criação e otimização de pipelines.
  • Implementar lógica e análises utilizando DAX.
  • Modelar dados (normalização, desnormalização e star schema).
  • Desenvolver e otimizar modelos DBT, incluindo criação de testes de dados.
  • Atuar com soluções em Azure para armazenamento, integração e processamento de dados.
  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes Azure DevOps: acessos, permissões, configurações de projeto, repositórios e integrações.
  • Colaborar com stakeholders internos e externos para avaliar automações, integrações e fluxos customizados dentro do Azure DevOps.
  • Oferecer direcionamento técnico sobre uso avançado da plataforma Azure DevOps, incluindo escalabilidade e integrações com GitHub, ServiceNow e serviços Azure.
  • Criar e manter automações utilizando Power Platform (principalmente Power Automate).
  • Comunicar conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos técnicos e não técnicos em inglês.

O que você precisa ter

  • Forte experiência em administração de Azure DevOps (ADO) e pipelines.
  • Experiência sólida com Power Platform, principalmente Power Automate.
  • SQL avançado (mandatório).
  • Experiência com ADF, Data Pipelines e orquestração de dados.
  • Conhecimento em DBT e DAX.
  • Conhecimentos de Azure Infrastructure.
  • Experiência em liderança técnica.
  • Inglês avançado (mandatório)

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

Experiência com Python ou PowerQuery/Power BI.

Certificações relevantes:

  • DP-203 – Azure Data Engineer Associate
  • PL-500 – Power Platform Developer Associate

title: Remote Mathematics Expert - 79192
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Mathematics Expert - 79192 em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview:We are seeking highly skilled and motivated mathematicians with a strong understanding of intermediate to advanced mathematical concepts and the ability to apply these concepts creatively to complex problems. This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in tackling challenging questions and have a passion for deep mathematical reasoning and problem-solving. We are hiring both individuals who are strong in undergraduate level mathematics and as well as those who are strong in masters/PhD level mathematics. Turing works with most of the leading LLM companies in the world today and your work will enable today's leading LLMs to attain advanced mathematics proficiency.Key Responsibilities: Develop and implement advanced mathematical models and computational techniques to address complex problems across diverse mathematical domains. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams on research initiatives, providing mathematical expertise and analytical insights. Review and engage with the latest mathematical literature, including cutting-edge research papers and emerging methodologies. Apply quantitative and computational approaches to analyze data, optimize models, and support innovative problem-solving strategies. Contribute to the advancement of research projects through rigorous mathematical reasoning and technical proficiency.Desired Skills and Qualifications: Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Mathematics or a closely related field, with strong expertise in one or more of the following areas: computable functions and mathematical logic, algebra and number theory, linear algebra and matrix theory, topology and geometry, real analysis, probability, and statistics. Proven ability to solve complex mathematical problems, demonstrated through research experience, publications, academic achievements, or project work. Knowledge of Python and data analysis tools is preferred, though not mandatory. Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills, with strong attention to detail and problem-solving capabilities. Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex mathematical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Collaborative mindset with experience working in multidisciplinary teams on research-driven or project-based initiatives.More details on required skills: Candidates should demonstrate strong expertise in at least 4 of the following 7 domains, with broader coverage considered a significant advantage: Computable Functions and Mathematical Logic Strong understanding of the theory of computation, computable functions, decision problems, and strategies for inferring functions from input-output relationships. Algebra and Number Theory Deep knowledge of algebraic structures, quadratic forms, signatures, prime numbers, Eisenstein series, and related concepts in number theory and their applications. Linear Algebra and Matrix Theory Proficiency in linear spaces, basis transformations, symmetric matrices, matrix equations, matrix diagonalization, and rank-related conditions. Topology and Geometry Understanding of vector bundles, cohomology, fundamental groups, commensurability, topological spaces, vector fields, and geometric proof techniques. Analysis Strong foundation in real analysis, including properties of functions almost everywhere, convergence concepts, continuity, and advanced analytical reasoning. Probability and Statistics Ability to apply probability theory to evaluate outcomes under varying conditions, along with experience using statistical techniques such as ANOVA for experimental and data analysis. Applied Mathematics Capability to apply mathematical reasoning and problem-solving techniques to practical scenarios, including logic-based and analytical challenges.Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: ContractorEvaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Data Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.

Nosso Cliente

Você irá atuar em um projeto global do nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do setor de óleo e gás, assumindo um papel técnico-estratégico dedicado ao Azure DevOps (ADO) e às plataformas de dados.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Trabalhar com estruturas de dados de média a alta complexidade em ambiente corporativo.
  • Atuar de forma hands-on com SQL para manipulação e análise de dados.
  • Transformar dados utilizando Azure Data Factory (ADF), incluindo criação e otimização de pipelines.
  • Implementar lógica e análises utilizando DAX.
  • Modelar dados (normalização, desnormalização e star schema).
  • Desenvolver e otimizar modelos DBT, incluindo criação de testes de dados.
  • Atuar com soluções em Azure para armazenamento, integração e processamento de dados.
  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes Azure DevOps: acessos, permissões, configurações de projeto, repositórios e integrações.
  • Colaborar com stakeholders internos e externos para avaliar automações, integrações e fluxos customizados dentro do Azure DevOps.
  • Oferecer direcionamento técnico sobre uso avançado da plataforma Azure DevOps, incluindo escalabilidade e integrações com GitHub, ServiceNow e serviços Azure.
  • Criar e manter automações utilizando Power Platform (principalmente Power Automate).
  • Comunicar conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos técnicos e não técnicos em inglês.

O que você precisa ter

  • Forte experiência em administração de Azure DevOps (ADO) e pipelines.
  • Experiência sólida com Power Platform, principalmente Power Automate.
  • SQL avançado (mandatório).
  • Experiência com ADF, Data Pipelines e orquestração de dados.
  • Conhecimento em DBT e DAX.
  • Conhecimentos de Azure Infrastructure.
  • Experiência em liderança técnica.
  • Inglês avançado (mandatório)

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

Experiência com Python ou PowerQuery/Power BI.

Certificações relevantes:

  • DP-203 – Azure Data Engineer Associate
  • PL-500 – Power Platform Developer Associate

Experiência em ambientes corporativos com estruturas de dados complexas.

Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e atenção a detalhes.

title: English Teacher With Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English Teacher With Advanced Portuguese Skills em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Sap Finance & R2r Data Migration Expert - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sap Finance & R2r Data Migration Expert - Brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

RED Global is looking for an experienced SAP Business Data Migration Finance expert to support a global S/4 Hana template rollout for one of our international clients. This role will focus on Record to Report (R2R) and Finance processes, specifically in customer master data, business partners, credit management, and accounts receivables.

  • Coordinate and perform data cleansing tasks
  • Ensure data readiness and integration across systems to support seamless deployment.

Desired Skills:

  • 8+ years of experience in SAP data migration and ERP implementations (S/4 Hana).
  • Strong understanding and focus on GL, P&L, accounts receivables, accounts payables, cost centers, WBS, Internal orders
  • Proven experience in SAP data cleansing, mapping, and validation.
  • Ability to work with global deployment teams and manage multi-country projects.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to negotiate and find compromises.
  • Strong planning and deadline management skills.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills for data analysis and reconciliation.

Location: Brazil-100% Remote

Role Type: Contract (6 months with possible extension)

Start Date: ASAP

Language: English + Portuguese

Rate: USD / day

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (Elixir/Ruby/React)

Location: Brazil, Costa Rica, Colombia

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits;
candidate responsible for own taxes)

Contract Duration: 6 months, with possibility of extension

Hours: 40 hours per week

About The Role:

- Produce high-quality, performant, and testable code that directly contributes to company-wide initiatives

- Develop using interesting technologies -- Elixir, Ruby, React, Typescript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS/Lambda, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB

- Have input into technical decisions that will shape the future of our software systems

- Learn something new, whether it's a new software design pattern or a new initiative to push the company forward

- Review pulls requests and provide constructive feedback to your peers

- Pair up with a team member to work together on features

- Deploy user-facing code to production

- Act as a strong partner to product and engineering management

Requirements:

- 3-5+ years of software engineering experience

- Strong communication skills

- Understanding of reusable components/building component libraries

- Understanding of building production-ready web applications and systems

- Passionate about testing practices and continuous improvement

- Experience with any of Elixir, Erlang, Ruby, Javascript, NextJs, or another programming language

- Familiarity with common programming tools such as IDEs, RESTful APIs, Git repositories, TypeScript, version control software, and remote deployment tools

- Bachelor of Computer Science degree or equivalent experience

- Familiarity with event-based architectures, database fundamentals and GraphQL

- Enthusiasm for solving problems for our users with technology

- Curiosity about retail/e-commerce, the high-end consignment market, and/or how to create a sustainable, circular economy for luxury goods

Preferred Requirements:

- Experience with Javascript, HTML, CSS, and React

- Experience with Kafka for event-streaming

- Experience with GraphQL

- Experience with Storybook

- Experience building microservices

- Experience building eCommerce platforms

- Experience working with a CMS, especially Prismic

- Any experience with mobile development for iOS and/or Android

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Full Stack Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.Js and Node.Js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn.

The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software!

Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.

Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs
  • Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.Js and Node.Js
  • Develop and implement highly responsive UI components
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles, implementing them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers, helping them find and build solutions to their problems

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single-page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.Js, Node.Js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks
  • Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models
  • Experience working in an AWS (preferred), GCP, Azure, or other cloud environments
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A focus on customer value delivery
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake

Desired Experience

  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field

Additional Information

  • Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

Core Client Values

  • The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust: We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable.
  • Health: We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team.
  • Respect: We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk.
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners.
  • Accountability: We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do.
  • Diversity: We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger.
  • The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.

About Velozient

We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Scm Consultant - Asset Management
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Microsoft Dynamics 365 Scm Consultant - Asset Management em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM Consultant – Asset Management

Local: Brasil (Remoto)

Senioridade: Sênior

Idioma: Inglês fluente (obrigatório)

Modalidade: Consultoria / Projeto de Implementação

Sobre a Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management Consultant com sólida experiência em Asset Management / Enterprise Asset Management para atuar em um projeto de implementação ou evolução do Dynamics 365.

O(a) profissional ideal é um(a) consultor(a) funcional sênior, com domínio dos processos de supply chain e manutenção — incluindo estrutura de ativos, manutenção preventiva e corretiva, ordens de serviço, peças de reposição, estoque, compras e integração de custos.

Esta é uma posição funcional sênior, com responsabilidade de conduzir workshops, levantar e desafiar requisitos de negócio, desenhar processos TO-BE, configurar o Dynamics 365 SCM, apoiar testes e atuar lado a lado com stakeholders de negócio e times técnicos.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir workshops funcionais com áreas de manutenção, operações, supply chain, compras, estoque, armazém, produção e finanças.
  • Analisar processos AS-IS e desenhar processos TO-BE para Asset Management e operações de manutenção.
  • Configurar o Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM, com foco no módulo de Asset Management.

  • Colaborar com desenvolvedores, arquitetos de solução, gerentes de projeto e stakeholders de negócio.
  • Recomendar boas práticas para Dynamics 365 SCM e processos de Asset Management.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sênior como consultor(a) funcional em Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations / Supply Chain Management.
  • Experiência hands-on em configuração do Dynamics 365 SCM.
  • Vivência em Asset Management, Enterprise Asset Management, manutenção industrial ou plant maintenance.
  • Forte entendimento de processos de manutenção: preventiva, corretiva, ordens de serviço, planejamento de manutenção, hierarquia de ativos e consumo de peças.
  • Experiência integrando Asset Management com compras, estoque, armazém, produção, custos ou finanças.
  • Capacidade de liderar workshops e se comunicar com stakeholders sêniores.
  • Experiência em elaboração de especificações funcionais, documentação de processos, scripts de teste e materiais de apoio a UAT.
  • Inglês fluente (mandatório) para reuniões, documentação e interação com times globais.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em ambiente de consultoria / projeto.

Diferenciais

  • Certificação Microsoft em Dynamics 365 SCM (MB-330 ou similares).
  • Experiência em setores industrial, manufatura, utilities, mineração, óleo & gás, logística ou facilities.
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI, integrações, IoT ou sistemas externos de manutenção.
  • Experiência com migração de dados, planejamento de cutover e suporte a go-live.
  • Conhecimento em SAP PM, SAP EAM, Maximo, Infor EAM ou outros sistemas EAM.

Buscamos um(a) profissional funcional sênior, capaz de traduzir requisitos de negócio de manutenção e supply chain em configuração e design funcional no Dynamics 365 SCM. Conhecimento técnico é bem-vindo, mas o foco principal está na expertise funcional em Dynamics 365 SCM e Asset Management.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Full Stack Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.Js and Node.Js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn.

The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software!

Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.

Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs
  • Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.Js and Node.Js
  • Develop and implement highly responsive UI components
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles, implementing them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers, helping them find and build solutions to their problems

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single-page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.Js, Node.Js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks
  • Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models
  • Experience working in an AWS (preferred), GCP, Azure, or other cloud environments
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A focus on customer value delivery
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake

Desired Experience

  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field

Additional Information

  • Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

Core Client Values

  • The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust: We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable.

  • Diversity: We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger.

It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.

We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Contract Review Attorney
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Contract Review Attorney em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Headshots.ComAt Headshots.Com, we're reimagining how professional headshots are created and delivered. Trusted by clients like Boeing, Capital One, and American Express, we transform smartphone selfies into polished, studio-quality portraits within three business days. As our enterprise client base expands across industries and geographies, including a growing footprint in regulated healthcare environments, we are building out our legal function to support that growth.We're looking for a Contract Review Attorney, reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, who will own the day-to-day review and negotiation of commercial agreements, partner closely with our business teams, and help us scale a thoughtful, risk-calibrated approach to enterprise contracting.About the Role This role combines hands-on contract review with a strategic understanding of how commercial terms translate into operational risk and opportunity. You will be the primary reviewer on incoming Master Services Agreements, Business Associate Agreements, Data Processing Addenda, Statements of Work, and vendor contracts. You will work directly with leadership to redline, negotiate, and finalize agreements that protect the company while preserving the speed and flexibility that allow us to serve enterprise clients well.We are looking for someone who brings both technical legal expertise and strong commercial judgment, someone who can identify which provisions matter, where to push, and where to accept reasonable client positions in service of getting deals closed.Key Responsibilities Lead the review and redlining of MSAs, BAAs, DPAs, SOWs, NDAs, and vendor agreements. Identify risk, draft fallback positions, and negotiate directly with client legal teams when needed. Translate complex legal terms into clear, plain-language recommendations for the business. Coordinate with the business on Standard Contractual Clauses, data transfer impact assessments, and DPA terms. Negotiate indemnification, limitation of liability, insurance requirements, IP ownership, audit rights, termination, and assignment provisions in a way that is proportionate to our scope and revenue. Develop playbooks and fallback positions so the business can move quickly on standard issues. Maintain contract templates, position playbooks, and a clause library. Work directly with sales, operations, and leadership to support active deal cycles. Translate legal positions into commercial recommendations. Provide guidance during pre-contract discussions so issues are surfaced early. Track the status of in-flight negotiations and ensure timely follow-up with client counterparties.What You Bring Experience & Qualifications Law degree (JD or LLM) from an accredited institution Six or more years of commercial contracts experience, with meaningful time spent in-house or supporting in-house teams. 5+ years of demonstrated experience reviewing and negotiating agreements (US and European commercial clients a plus) Working knowledge of GDPR and cross-border data transfer requirements. Strong command of commercial provisions: indemnification, limitation of liability, IP ownership, insurance, confidentiality, data security, termination, and assignment. Familiarity with SaaS, professional services, and vendor agreements. Excellent English skills, both written and spoken.Mindset & Strengths Commercial pragmatism. You understand that legal review serves business outcomes, and you know when to push, when to compromise, and when to escalate. Clear written communication. You can explain complex legal positions to non-lawyers in plain language and translate client redlines into clear recommendations. Calm and thorough under deadline pressure. You can manage multiple active negotiations without losing track of detail. Independent operator. You can run a contract review process end-to-end with limited supervision and know when to surface issues to leadership. Discretion and trustworthiness. You handle confidential business information with care. A no-ego collaborator. You build trust through transparent communication, take ownership of your work, and welcome feedback.Why Join Us Fully remote, flexible schedule with ET overlap. Work directly with founders and executive leadership on agreements that shape the company's growth. Opportunity to build out the legal function and contracting infrastructure at a fast-moving company. Exposure to a diverse, enterprise client base across industries and geographies.IMPORTANT Direct inquiries will disqualify candidates.Compensation:$40-60/hour depending on experience

Esta é uma posição funcional sênior, com responsabilidade de conduzir workshops, levantar e desafiar requisitos de negócio, desenhar processos TO-BE, configurar o Dynamics 365 SCM, apoiar testes e atuar lado a lado com stakeholders de negócio e times técnicos.

  • Forte entendimento de processos de manutenção: preventiva, corretiva, ordens de serviço, planejamento de manutenção, hierarquia de ativos e consumo de peças.

title: Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor De Busca)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor De Busca) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país. Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução da experiência de busca, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia e Negócio.Responsabilidades: Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional. Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual) Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância. Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados. Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento. Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas.Requisitos necessários Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados. Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância. Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual). Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank. Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados. Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem. Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto. Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos. Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps. Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.Diferenciais Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes. Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery. Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca. Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling. Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.Perfil esperado Forte mentalidade de produto e experiência do usuário. Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto. Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta. Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados. Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares.#SeleçãoSBF #VempraSBF

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Service Representative em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Instead of applying to one remote job, you could access a community where new remote opportunities become available every week. At Virtual Latinos, we connect experienced professionals from Latin America with growing companies in the U.S., Canada, and beyond that are building distributed remote teams. Our community includes more than 5,000+ professionals hired and 2,500+ companies that rely on Virtual Latinos to find skilled remote talent.Join a community where you'll learn, connect with like-minded professionals, and access real remote opportunities with top North American companies.Highlight Role of the Week!Customer Service Specialist (Remote)About the role:This opportunity is designed for experienced customer service professionals who are comfortable managing multi-channel support operations, resolving complex inquiries, handling escalations, and delivering high-quality customer experiences in fast-paced remote environments.Pay Rates:Part-Time Monthly Rates: $840-$$1,400 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)Full-Time Monthly Rates: $1,680-$2,800 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)The posted monthly salary range is an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly, and pay is calculated based on the number of hours worked daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10.50 - $17.50, depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.Work Schedule:The work schedule will vary depending on the position and client. Most schedules align with U.S. and Canadian business hours.Key responsibilities:Multi-Channel Customer Support:Handle customer inquiries across phone, email, live chat, and social media, ensuring timely, professional, and solution-oriented responses. Escalation & Problem Resolution:Diagnose complex customer issues, troubleshoot effectively, and manage escalations through resolution while maintaining customer satisfaction and retention. Account Management & CRM Administration:Update and maintain accurate customer records, process account changes, and ensure data integrity within CRM and helpdesk systems (Zendesk, Freshdesk, HubSpot, Intercom, or similar). Product & Service Expertise:Maintain deep knowledge of products, services, and internal processes to provide accurate guidance and proactive recommendations to customers. Reporting & Process Improvement:Document customer interactions, identify recurring issues and trends, and provide actionable feedback to support teams and leadership to improve service quality.Depending on the client, you may also support order processing, returns management, knowledge base maintenance, or quality assurance initiatives.What you bring:Must be 21+ years old 3+ years of experience in customer service, customer support, or client-facing roles Bilingual English (C1 or above) / Spanish Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Communications, or a related field preferredRequired Skills:Strong understanding of customer service best practices, support workflows, and escalation procedures Experience working with CRM or helpdesk platforms (Zendesk, Freshdesk, HubSpot, Intercom, Salesforce Service Cloud, LiveAgent, Zoho Desk, or similar) Familiarity with communication and collaboration tools (Slack, Microsoft Teams, Dialpad, RingCentral, Aircall, or similar) Experience with ticketing and knowledge base systems (Jira Service Management, Help Scout, Confluence, Notion, or similar) Proficiency in productivity and scheduling tools (Google Workspace, Microsoft Office 365, Calendly, or similar) Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish Ability to manage multiple conversations and priorities simultaneously in remote environments Strong organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail Empathetic, patient communication style with a focus on customer retention Comfortable handling confidential customer information with discretionHow the process works:Apply through LinkedIn Easy Apply. Qualified candidates will receive instructions to complete their full application and join the Virtual Latinos community. Once accepted, you will gain access to ongoing remote job opportunities with U.S. companies looking for experienced remote professionals.

title: Remote Biology Expert - 78715
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Biology Expert - 78715 em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Turing:Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&LRole Overview: In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have a solid foundation in Biology, particularly at the level expected in engineering entrance exams, as well as graduate or PhD-level programs. You should be able to break down complex biological concepts into simple, clear explanations and work efficiently. The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!Responsibilities: Design and solve challenging Biology problems to probe the limitations of large language models. Develop high-quality, step-by-step solutions with clear and rigorous reasoning. Collaborate with LLM researchers to align problem types with evaluation goals, especially in areas where models typically struggle (e.G., conceptual abstraction, multi-step reasoning, and data interpretation). Contribute to defining new evaluation benchmarks based on Biology curricula spanning early undergraduate to PhD-level topics.Required Qualifications: Candidates with a Master's or Ph.D., or those currently pursuing a Ph.D./Postdoctoral degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or a related field are encouraged to apply. Strong research and analytical skills. Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Creative and lateral thinking abilities. Excellent structured communication and collaboration skills in a remote setting. Self-motivated and able to work independently. Access to a desktop/laptop with a reliable internet connection. Ability to analyze and solve complex biological problems with a structured, logical approach. Ability to explain biology concepts clearly using simple language, visuals, and simulations where needed.Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: ContractorEvaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

Experiência com Logística, com vivência obrigatória em projetos/processos de WMS e TMS (implantação, evolução, rollout ou sustentação). Vivência em levantamento e documentação de requisitos (funcionais e regras de negócio). Experiência com mapeamento de processos (AS-IS/TO-BE) e documentação de fluxos. Participação em ciclos de testes (SIT/UAT), validação de entregas e suporte ao usuário de negócio. Experiência em rotinas de acompanhamento e comunicação de evolução (status, alinhamentos, priorização).
