title: Principal .Net Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Principal .Net Architect em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Our client is a globally established, product-led technology organisation currently undergoing a large-scale platform and security transformation. They offer an excellent salary package, great benefits, and a very good team environment. With low attrition and a solid, experienced team, they provide a nice working environment and strong career progression opportunities. Having partnered with them for several years, we've seen their consistent investment in people and technology.

They are hiring a senior technical leader with a strong blend of .NET expertise, IAM knowledge, and leadership experience. This role requires someone who can operate across architecture and hands-on delivery, guiding teams through a complex modernisation journey.

You should be confident working in Agile environments, engaging with global stakeholders, and translating high-level strategy into clear technical direction. Strong English communication is essential.

Core Responsibilities

You will lead the architectural evolution of a business-critical platform, focusing on improving scalability, security, and maintainability. This includes defining a modern target architecture and supporting the transition from legacy systems to cloud-ready solutions.

As a .NET expert, you will review existing C# codebases, identify risks, and guide refactoring aligned with modern standards. You will also take ownership of Identity & Access Management architecture, ensuring secure authentication and authorization aligned with OAuth2, OIDC, and JWT.

Collaboration is key — you will work closely with cross-functional teams across engineering, product, and infrastructure, while also supporting Agile delivery by translating architecture into clear technical tasks.

You will regularly communicate with senior stakeholders, providing clear updates on progress, risks, and technical decisions.

Key Skills Required

  • Strong experience with C# and .NET architecture (modern and legacy systems)
  • Proven expertise in Identity & Access Management (IAM)
  • Solid understanding of OAuth2, OIDC, and JWT protocols
  • Experience with platform modernisation (cloud migration, refactoring, system upgrades)
  • Strong background in distributed and cloud-native architectures
  • Knowledge of APIs, microservices, and integration patterns
  • Experience working in Agile (Scrum / Kanban) environments
  • Ability to translate architecture into technical deliverables (epics, user stories)
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication

Nice to Have

  • Experience with large-scale system transformation projects
  • Exposure to database modernisation and data architecture
  • Background in mentoring teams and setting engineering standards
  • Experience working in globally distributed teams

description:

Talent Acquisition Partner (Active Sourcing) Location: Fully Remote (Must be based in LATAM) Job Type: Full-TimeAbout Uproot Clean Uproot Clean is a fast-growing consumer products company with more than 5 million customers using our products. Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. Uproot has also been featured across major television and media platforms, including QVC, Good Morning America, and Fox, helping introduce millions of consumers to the brand. We care deeply about building products that genuinely solve problems for pet owners while operating with high standards across every part of the business. We are building a company focused on long-term excellence, creating significant opportunities for highly capable people who want real and meaningful impact, and the ability to help shape the future of the company. About the Role This is a hands-on execution role focused 100% on active sourcing. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach. Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.ResponsibilitiesActive Sourcing Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels Identify strong passive candidates Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs. Candidate Outreach Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement Qualify candidates early in the process Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow Pipeline Management Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting What Success Looks Like Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions Generates strong response and assessment completion rates Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight Raises the overall talent bar of the company over timeRequirements Must Have 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques Excellent written English communication skills Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously Strong Plus Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools Work Requirements Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads) Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)Who This Role Is For (& Not For) This Role Is For You If: You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does You are naturally proactive and internally driven You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time This Role Is NOT For You If: You need constant direction or external motivation You struggle with consistency and follow-through You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination onlyCompensation & Benefits Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience. Salary: Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company's growth and direction Fully remote: work from anywhere PTO: 2 Weeks Flex Day: An additional quarterly day off dedicated to rest and recovery Thinking Day:one dedicated day each quarter to step away from day-to-day execution and think deeply about your role, systems, ideas, and long-term impact Wellness Reimbursement: $100-$300/month, based on location, to help support your wellness. Pet Reimbursement: $40-100/month, based on location to help support parenting a pet. Coaching credits:$1,000+/year for coaching, education, and professional developmentReady to Apply? If you are excited by high standards, proactive recruiting, and the challenge of building world-class talent pipelines, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Partner em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Partner (Active Sourcing) Location: Fully Remote (Must be based in LATAM) Job Type: Full-TimeAbout Uproot Clean Uproot Clean is a fast-growing consumer products company with more than 5 million customers using our products. Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. Uproot has also been featured across major television and media platforms, including QVC, Good Morning America, and Fox, helping introduce millions of consumers to the brand. We care deeply about building products that genuinely solve problems for pet owners while operating with high standards across every part of the business. We are building a company focused on long-term excellence, creating significant opportunities for highly capable people who want real and meaningful impact, and the ability to help shape the future of the company. About the Role This is a hands-on execution role focused 100% on active sourcing. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach. Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.ResponsibilitiesActive Sourcing Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels Identify strong passive candidates Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs. Candidate Outreach Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement Qualify candidates early in the process Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow Pipeline Management Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting What Success Looks Like Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions Generates strong response and assessment completion rates Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight Raises the overall talent bar of the company over timeRequirements Must Have 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques Excellent written English communication skills Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously Strong Plus Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools Work Requirements Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads) Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)Who This Role Is For (& Not For) This Role Is For You If: You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does You are naturally proactive and internally driven You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time This Role Is NOT For You If: You need constant direction or external motivation You struggle with consistency and follow-through You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination onlyCompensation & Benefits Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience. Salary: Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company's growth and direction Fully remote: work from anywhere PTO: 2 Weeks Flex Day: An additional quarterly day off dedicated to rest and recovery Thinking Day:one dedicated day each quarter to step away from day-to-day execution and think deeply about your role, systems, ideas, and long-term impact Wellness Reimbursement: $100-$300/month, based on location, to help support your wellness. Pet Reimbursement: $40-100/month, based on location to help support parenting a pet. Coaching credits:$1,000+/year for coaching, education, and professional developmentReady to Apply? If you are excited by high standards, proactive recruiting, and the challenge of building world-class talent pipelines, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Sênior - Inglês Avançado - Home Office
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Java Sênior - Inglês Avançado - Home Office em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

DESENVOLVEDOR BACK-END JAVA SENIOR (COM INGLÊS AVANÇADO)

Sobre o desafio

Fará parte de um time de tecnologia altamente colaborativo, atuando em projetos estratégicos que envolvem soluções digitais, integrações complexas e construção de plataformas escaláveis na nuvem.

O foco principal será o desenvolvimento de aplicações backend robustas, seguras e performáticas, utilizando boas práticas de arquitetura e engenharia de software, com forte atuação em cloud (GCP) e ambientes distribuídos.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend em Java, garantindo qualidade, performance e escalabilidade.
  • Projetar e implementar APIs RESTful, assegurando boas práticas de versionamento, documentação e segurança.
  • Aplicar princípios de arquitetura moderna, com foco em Arquitetura Hexagonal e desacoplamento entre camadas.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com arquitetos, POs e demais desenvolvedores na definição de soluções técnicas aderentes ao negócio.
  • Implementar testes automatizados (unitários e integrados), garantindo alta cobertura e confiabilidade do código.
  • Atuar na evolução contínua dos pipelines de CI/CD utilizando GitLab, garantindo entregas frequentes e seguras.
  • Participar de decisões técnicas e revisões de código, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua do time.
  • Garantir a observabilidade e estabilidade das aplicações em ambiente cloud (GCP).


Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos com desenvolvimento backend em Java.
  • Domínio do ecossistema Spring: Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security e Spring Cloud.
  • Experiência com Hibernate e ferramentas de build como Maven.
  • Conhecimento sólido em testes com JUnit e Mockito.
  • Experiência com versionamento de banco de dados utilizando Flyway.
  • Familiaridade com Lombok e geração de relatórios com JasperReports.
  • Experiência na construção e documentação de APIs REST com Swagger/OpenAPI.
  • Vivência com Arquitetura Hexagonal (Ports & Adapters).
  • Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD utilizando GitLab.
  • Experiência com Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experiência com microsserviços e arquiteturas distribuídas.
  • Conhecimento em mensageria (Kafka, Pub/Sub ou similares).
  • Inglês avançado para conversação (imprescindível).
  • Formação Acadêmica completo em cursos correlatos a TI


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com observabilidade (monitoramento, logs e tracing).
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Experiência no setor automotivo ou em empresas de grande porte.


Perfil esperado

  • Forte senso de responsabilidade sobre qualidade e entrega.
  • Capacidade analítica e visão sistêmica para resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração com times multidisciplinares.
  • Proatividade na identificação de melhorias técnicas e evolução da arquitetura.
  • Interesse contínuo por aprendizado, inovação e boas práticas de engenharia.

title: Applied Scientist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Applied Scientist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Senior Applied Scientist - Computer Vision & Machine Learning

Location: Brazil

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits;
candidate responsible for own taxes)

Contract Duration: 6 months, with possibility of extension

Hours: 40 hours per week


About the Role

The Inbound team develops highly scalable solutions to determine item attribute values (such as color, material, and style) and verify merchandise authenticity. The Senior Applied Scientist will own the development and deployment of machine learning solutions while influencing the technical direction of the team.

This role works closely with Tech Leads, Product, and Engineering partners to design and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Computer Vision and Machine Learning, along with a strong focus on building robust production-ready systems and mentoring team members.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and deploy Computer Vision and Machine Learning solutions to solve business problems.
  • Maintain clean, efficient, and scalable code that meets industry standards.
  • Analyze large datasets to extract actionable insights and support informed decision-making.
  • Apply state-of-the-art Machine Learning methodologies and frameworks to develop robust and scalable models.
  • Influence technical direction and take ownership of key system components and solutions to ensure business needs are met.
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders to develop data-driven solutions and deployable products.
  • Mentor team members and help establish domain expertise across the team.
  • Contribute to the company’s intellectual property and technical leadership through patents and publications at top-tier conferences and journals.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of industry experience in Computer Vision and applied Machine Learning.
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field, or 8+ years of equivalent industry experience.
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing machine learning and deep learning models in large-scale production environments.
  • Deep understanding of Computer Vision and Machine Learning algorithms and techniques, including CNNs, transformers, GANs, optimizers, and regularization, as well as experiment design and best practices such as A/B testing, training and serving pipelines, and feature engineering.
  • Extensive experience with scientific Python libraries such as NumPy and pandas, and Machine Learning frameworks including PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, and Scikit-Learn.
  • Strong data engineering skills and experience working with large-scale datasets.
  • Experience with experiment automation frameworks such as Ray Tune, Weights & Biases (W&B), and Kubeflow.
  • Experience with cloud technologies including AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Fluency in Python.


Preferred Requirements

  • PhD preferred in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field.
  • Background applying Machine Learning techniques to solve real-world business problems in the retail sector.
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and pipelines.
  • Impact-focused mindset with a passion for delivering high-quality models.

title: Customer Support Representative, Level 1
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Support Representative, Level 1 em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Customer Support Representative to be on the front lines by answering questions and troubleshooting technical problems. You will assist customers with JoVE’s products and also guide clients through any technical issue they might encounter. If you are an energetic self-starter problem solver with a basic technical background and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you. The Support Team here at JoVE is providing support not only to external customers but also to internal JoVE employees on a 24x7 basis.


Responsibilities:


  • Manage large amounts of incoming tickets.
  • Provide support to answer inquiries on products.
  • Accept and handle technical requests.
  • Triage tickets to the correct L2 teams.
  • Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies.
  • Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools.
  • Build sustainable relationships and trust with customers through open communication.
  • Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits;
    follow up to ensure resolution.
  • Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents.
  • Take the extra mile to engage customers.
  • Performs other specific duties or assignments as directed by Team Manager.


Skills And Qualifications:


  • A Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related field.
  • 2+ years of demonstrable experience in technical customer support.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, verbal and written, are required to effectively and accurately communicate in English.
  • Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical personnel in a clear and easy fashion.
  • Possess an attention to detail.
  • Basic understanding of KPIs and Metrics.
  • Must be able to accommodate flexible work schedules based on business needs.
  • Must have technical/diagnostic ability along with analytical ability to diagnose problems above basics, and basic mechanical skills.
  • Basic understanding of frameworks such as Agile, ITIL, COBIT.
  • Proficient with ticketing tools ( Zendesk, Jira, Salesforce).


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Senior Cisco Ucs Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Cisco Ucs Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer - Cisco UCS expert to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US.


MUST BE fluent in English.


The Senior Infrastructure Engineer provides advanced technical expertise within the Managed Services organization and serves as a senior escalation point for complex infrastructure issues. This role is primarily focused on Cisco UCS compute, VMware vCenter/vSphere virtualization, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (VDI) environments.

In addition to resolving advanced incidents, this role contributes to technical leadership, root cause analysis, documentation, and the planning and implementation of infrastructure solutions delivered through Professional Services engagements.

Senior Infrastructure Engineers are expected to have deep expertise in the core technology areas listed below, with a broad understanding of adjacent infrastructure disciplines.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Own the full lifecycle of complex infrastructure incidents, from detection through resolution and post-incident review, ensuring accountability for technical outcomes, stability, and documentation.
  • Lead investigation and resolution of critical incidents, driving coordination across internal teams, vendors, and customer stakeholders.
  • Make technical decisions and take end-to-end ownership of infrastructure issues, driving resolution without reliance on further escalation.
  • Lead technical delivery of infrastructure projects, including scoping, estimation, design, and implementation.
  • Perform root cause analysis and develop long-term remediation strategies to prevent recurrence.
  • Validate and approve infrastructure changes, designs, and remediation strategies.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers.
  • Contribute to architecture documentation, diagrams, and operational runbooks.
  • Design and implement automation and process improvements to enhance reliability and operational efficiency.
  • Participate in change management and project planning activities.
  • Accurately track time and project activities within the company's time tracking system.



Requirements

  • 8+ years of IT Infrastructure experience.
  • MUST BE fluent in English.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with Cisco UCS — including blade/rack server administration, Fabric Interconnects, UCS Manager (UCSM) or Intersight, service profiles, and firmware management.
  • Deep experience with VMware vCenter and vSphere — including ESXi administration, vMotion, HA/DRS, distributed virtual switches, and VM lifecycle management.
  • Deep experience with Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD) or Citrix DaaS — including Delivery Controllers, StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, machine catalogs, and VDA troubleshooting.
  • Strong experience troubleshooting complex multi-system infrastructure issues.
  • Experience designing and implementing infrastructure solutions.


Preferred

  • Experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM) and enterprise voice/unified communications infrastructure.
  • Certifications such as Cisco CCNP/CCIE Data Center, VMware VCP-DCV, Citrix CCP-V, or equivalent cloud infrastructure certifications.
  • Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models.
  • Experience delivering customer-facing IT infrastructure projects.
  • Experience with enterprise storage platforms.
  • Familiarity with identity platforms (Active Directory, Okta), firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco FTD), and backup/disaster recovery solutions is a plus.

title: Senior Ml Engineer | Fully Remote | B2b
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Ml Engineer | Fully Remote | B2b em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence.


This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly.


About us

Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2B company intelligence platform.

We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer.

The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages.


Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, DevOps and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product.

The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well.

This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously.


Role description

As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo’s product.


Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection.

You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale.


The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, SageMaker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and TypeScript.

You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation.


Your work includes:

- Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection

- Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats

- Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production

- Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases

- Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value

- Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling

- Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time

- Working with AWS services such as Lambda, SageMaker, S3 and ECS

- Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows


This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them.


Requirements

You bring:

- At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience

- Strong Python skills

- Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3

- Real production experience with ML on AWS

- Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning

- Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data

- Experience with JSON, NoSQL data and scraped web content

- A strong eye for correctness and data quality

- Business level English

- The ability to work independently in a small remote team

- A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership


Conditions

- 12 month B2B contract

- Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap

- Flat structure with direct communication

- Production product with real users and real data problems

- Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence

- Compensation based on senior contractor level


The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team.


Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars

Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo’s needs.

title: Latam Decom Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Latam Decom Project Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company


Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.



About the Role


The LATAM Decom Project Manager leads large-scale delivery programs executed through Managed Service Providers (MSPs) for hyperscaler environments. This role ensures end-to-end delivery of datacenter, network, and infrastructure projects across global regions with strict adherence to SLAs, security standards, compliance frameworks, and operational excellence. The PM serves as the primary interface between the hyperscaler, MSPs, vendors, and internal engineering teams.



Responsibilities



Program & Project Delivery

  • Lead planning, execution, and delivery of MSP-supported projects across compute, network, storage, and data-center operations.
  • Manage project lifecycle including scoping, resourcing, budgets, timelines, risks, and change control.
  • Maintain alignment with hyperscaler operational frameworks, including capacity build-outs, decom, retrofits, and infra expansions.
  • Coordinate regional and global deployments across multiple time zones with follow-the-sun governance.


Vendor & MSP Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all ISPs delivering onsite or remote services.
  • Enforce SLA compliance & and quality KPIs.
  • Conduct regular governance calls, internal and external.
  • Drive corrective actions and continuous improvement with vendors.

Syniti’s Data First philosophy and enterprise data management platform supports data migration, data quality, data replication, data matching, master data management, analytics, data governance, and data strategy in a single, unified solution.



THE ROLE

The Lab Systems Architect plays a critical role in the success of Syniti’s Education Services department by designing, implementing, and maintaining technical lab environments that support both eLearning and instructor-led training. This role ensures the seamless operation of lab systems, supports integration with learning platforms, and collaborates cross-functionally to enhance system workflows and user experience. The ideal candidate is a technically skilled, detail-oriented problem solver with a passion for enabling learning through robust infrastructure.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Learning Lab Architecture & Management

  • Provide technical oversight for the design, testing, provisioning, and implementation of Learning Lab environments.
  • Manage and maintain lab snapshots, resolving configuration defects as they arise.
  • Optimize lab usage policies in collaboration with Education Coordinators and Leadership.
  • Monitor VM usage reports and metrics, ensuring alignment with budget and demand.
  • Support LMS system integrations as required.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for lab-related issues and liaise with solution providers to resolve complex problems across all learning lab platforms.


System Administration & Support

  • Allocate and reset user training accounts.
  • Stay current with new feature releases across all education platforms.
  • Provide on-call support for lab systems used in global training programs, including availability during evenings and weekends as needed.
  • Regularly review help desk tickets to identify recurring issues, usage patterns, and knowledge gaps. Recommend targeted training, updated documentation, or additional support resources to proactively address common challenges and improve user experience.
  • Train internal and partner instructors on lab systems.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate with Training Operations, Delivery Management, IT, and Application teams to improve workflows, system functionality, and user experience.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and requirements related to lab systems and processes.
  • Identify and resolve cross-functional issues to ensure company-wide alignment on lab system needs.


Reporting & Documentation

  • Document system configurations, best practices, and technical procedures.
  • Own and maintain the Education Services Revenue Report, providing monthly updates to Finance.
  • Support the creation and maintenance of Education Services forms, lists, automations, and integrations, as required.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one of the following databases: Oracle, MS SQL Server, IBM DB2, or MySQL.
  • Experience managing hypervisor solutions and SaaS platform architecture.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint.
  • Experience with Windows Server and Azure Active Directory.
  • Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Strong technical writing and documentation skills.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Knowledge of GraphQL queries and mutations (preferred).
  • Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for education technology and continuous improvement.



Be fully aligned to our core values:


  • Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
  • Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
  • Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
  • Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.



WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
  • Growth . We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support . We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you . We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition . We are the sum of individual achievements and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation . Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.



Our Commitment to Inclusion


At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Integration Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Integration Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We’ve built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we’re revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI.

We’re growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates NEA, and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI.

Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We’re working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.We’re building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow.


The Team

At Anterior, engineers share a strong “sense of product” and solve meaningful problems that simplify healthcare workflows. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design.

We’re building a dedicated deployments team focused on deploying our platform into large US enterprise healthcare environments. This team works closely with customers and our core platform engineers to ensure seamless, reliable integrations into complex payer systems of record.


About You

You have a passion for doing things The Right Way, you believe Less is More, you want to focus on the foundations of system design and architecture (pacelc, consistency guarantees), you care as much about the code you do not write, you’re tired of the hype treadmill and care about the fundamentals. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts.

Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You’ve worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges.

You’ve owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you’ve navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build.


About the Role

Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You’ll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into.

A day’s work may include:

  • Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems)
  • Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs
  • Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems
  • Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data
  • Owning UAT testing end-to-end, working with customer IT teams to validate data flows before go-live
  • Building internal tooling and shared integration patterns that make the next deployment faster
  • Contributing to Anterior’s SDKs, developer documentation, and integration playbooks
  • Collaborating closely with the core platform team in New York to ensure integration needs inform platform architecture


Tech

  • Langs: Python / TS
  • Infra: Nix, AWS
  • Healthcare data: FHIR, HL7 (experience preferred but not required — you’ll learn fast if you have strong API and data pipeline fundamentals)


What we’re looking for

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems
  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too
  • Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions
  • Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth
  • Strong written and spoken communication in English — you’ll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones
  • Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early
  • Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours


What’s in it for you

This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You’ll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Mid-Level Qc Manual Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Mid-Level Qc Manual Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the JobHiring Events is a live production product that receives a high volume of support requests from clients, often related to malfunctioning or misconfigured features. The team plays a critical role in diagnosing, triaging, and resolving these issues—particularly with in-progress hiring events that are not functioning as expected. This involves debugging issues across systems, collaborating closely with the Client Support and GTM teams, and maintaining high client satisfaction, measured in part by user ratings. Key Responsibilities: Analyze and troubleshoot production issues impacting live hiring events. Validate APIs and integrations using Postman. Reproduce, document, and track defects using Jira. Perform functional, regression, and end-to-end testing for hiring event workflows. Collaborate with Client Support, GTM, and engineering teams to resolve client issues. Monitor production systems and assist with incident triage and validation. Validate backend data using SQL and troubleshoot data inconsistencies. Support testing of architecture changes, integrations, and new platform releases. Investigate frontend and network issues using browser developer tools. Ensure timely issue resolution while meeting SLA expectations. Timezone Coverage: PST, MST, CST, EST (Across all U.S. timezones)Requirements Must-Have Skills: 3-5 yrs Strong experience with manual testing, including validating end-to-end workflows and user functionality. Experience with regression testing to ensure platform stability after releases and enhancements. Hands-on experience using Postman for API testing and response validation. Experience testing REST APIs and validating backend integrations/services. Strong SQL skills for backend data validation, troubleshooting, and test verification. Experience documenting defects, test results, and workflow issues within Jira. Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams including Product, Engineering, and Support. Experience working within Agile/Scrum environments, including sprint cycles, testing ceremonies, and release validation. Strong understanding of product functionality, user workflows, and business requirements. Ability to identify, design, and execute relevant test cases based on product requirements and business problems. Ability to interpret product needs and translate them into effective testing scenarios and validation plans. Experience with WCAG standards and accessibility tooling.Nice-to-Have Skills: Experience using Datadog for log review, monitoring, and troubleshooting. Familiarity with Kafka and asynchronous workflow validation. Exposure to MongoDB or other NoSQL databases for backend data validation. General understanding of CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, and release validation activities. Experience working with SaaS platforms or customer-facing/employer-facing applications.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior QA Automation Engineer with 5+ years of experience in quality assurance automation testing to join and focus on our U.S. clients' automation needs .Primary duties include testing all new feature enhancements, maintaining test cases, and overall regression testing of the application. This key individual should have experience making decisions and working both independently and as part of a small, dynamic team where everything you do makes a difference. Our client provides business-automating enterprise resource planning (ERP) software to the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across 9 countries.Responsibilities Create and execute test plans for existing products and features Establish test automation priorities, processes, and capabilities Develop and execute manual as well as automated tests Evaluate requirements and acceptance criteria as well as build scenarios, ensuring full traceability Work with the development team early in the software development lifecycle to define testing strategies and protocols for new featuresRequired Experience Excellent English communication and teamwork skills 5+ years of experience in quality assurance automation testing, including functional, bug verification, regression, user acceptance, and user experience testing, including testing services 3+ years of experience using Plawright Experience with Selenium and Cypress Strong experience with API testing and Postman Experience testing REST-based services Experience with project management tracking systems, such as Targetprocess Excellent troubleshooting capabilities and problem-solving skillsRequired AI Skills Prompt Engineering for Test Generation: Ability to craft precise prompts that produce structured, automation-ready test cases. This includes writing clear acceptance criteria, providing domain context (ERP, oil & gas terminology, UI element names), and iterating on output quality. Familiarity with chain-of-thought prompting and few-shot examples is expected AI-Assisted Test Case Review: Using LLM tools to review test cases for completeness, independence, and coverage gaps — not just accepting AI output at face value. The candidate must know how to validate AI suggestions against source requirements and flag hallucinations or incorrect domain assumptions Feedback Loop Literacy: Understands that AI test tools learn from corrections. Can submit high-quality, structured feedback (specific field names, exact navigation paths, corrected expected results) rather than vague complaints. Recognizes that correction quality directly affects future generation quality RAG and Knowledge Pipeline Awareness: Basic understanding of how retrieval-augmented generation works — why help documentation, existing test cases, and source code all contribute to AI output quality. Can identify when a knowledge source is missing or stale and knows how to escalate or fix itPreferred AI Skills / Experience Scripting with AI Assistance: Able to use AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex) to write test automation scripts, validation utilities, or data prep scripts. Does not need to be a full developer, but must be comfortable reviewing and debugging AI-generated code before running it AI-Powered Exploratory Testing: Uses AI to generate edge cases, boundary conditions, and negative scenarios beyond the obvious happy path. Can prompt an LLM with a feature spec and extract a prioritized list of risk areas to explore manually Documentation with AI: Leverages AI to produce and maintain QA documentation — test plans, bug reports, release notes, test coverage summaries. Produces clean, reviewable output rather than raw AI dumps Prompt-Driven Gap Analysis: Can use AI tools to compare existing test coverage against a work item backlog and identify untested or under-tested areas. Understands coverage metrics and can articulate why a gap exists, not just that one doesAdditional Information Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork! Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big! Making mistakes is human - let's learn from them - be transparent! We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidaysAbout Velozient We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior QA Automation Engineer with 5+ years of experience in quality assurance automation testing to join and focus on our U.S. clients' automation needs .Primary duties include testing all new feature enhancements, maintaining test cases, and overall regression testing of the application. This key individual should have experience making decisions and working both independently and as part of a small, dynamic team where everything you do makes a difference. Our client provides business-automating enterprise resource planning (ERP) software to the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across 9 countries.Responsibilities Create and execute test plans for existing products and features Establish test automation priorities, processes, and capabilities Develop and execute manual as well as automated tests Evaluate requirements and acceptance criteria as well as build scenarios, ensuring full traceability Work with the development team early in the software development lifecycle to define testing strategies and protocols for new featuresRequired Experience Excellent English communication and teamwork skills 5+ years of experience in quality assurance automation testing, including functional, bug verification, regression, user acceptance, and user experience testing, including testing services 3+ years of experience using Plawright Experience with Selenium and Cypress Strong experience with API testing and Postman Experience testing REST-based services Experience with project management tracking systems, such as Targetprocess Excellent troubleshooting capabilities and problem-solving skillsRequired AI Skills Prompt Engineering for Test Generation: Ability to craft precise prompts that produce structured, automation-ready test cases. This includes writing clear acceptance criteria, providing domain context (ERP, oil & gas terminology, UI element names), and iterating on output quality. Familiarity with chain-of-thought prompting and few-shot examples is expected AI-Assisted Test Case Review: Using LLM tools to review test cases for completeness, independence, and coverage gaps — not just accepting AI output at face value. The candidate must know how to validate AI suggestions against source requirements and flag hallucinations or incorrect domain assumptions Feedback Loop Literacy: Understands that AI test tools learn from corrections. Can submit high-quality, structured feedback (specific field names, exact navigation paths, corrected expected results) rather than vague complaints. Recognizes that correction quality directly affects future generation quality RAG and Knowledge Pipeline Awareness: Basic understanding of how retrieval-augmented generation works — why help documentation, existing test cases, and source code all contribute to AI output quality. Can identify when a knowledge source is missing or stale and knows how to escalate or fix itPreferred AI Skills / Experience Scripting with AI Assistance: Able to use AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex) to write test automation scripts, validation utilities, or data prep scripts. Does not need to be a full developer, but must be comfortable reviewing and debugging AI-generated code before running it AI-Powered Exploratory Testing: Uses AI to generate edge cases, boundary conditions, and negative scenarios beyond the obvious happy path. Can prompt an LLM with a feature spec and extract a prioritized list of risk areas to explore manually Documentation with AI: Leverages AI to produce and maintain QA documentation — test plans, bug reports, release notes, test coverage summaries. Produces clean, reviewable output rather than raw AI dumps Prompt-Driven Gap Analysis: Can use AI tools to compare existing test coverage against a work item backlog and identify untested or under-tested areas. Understands coverage metrics and can articulate why a gap exists, not just that one doesAdditional Information Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork! Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big! Making mistakes is human - let's learn from them - be transparent! We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidaysAbout Velozient We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Técnico de telecomunicação - correntina ba
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Técnico de telecomunicação - correntina ba em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Você conhece a Eletronet?
Somos uma empresa de telecomunicações que conecta o Brasil com uma das maiores redes de fibra óptica do país, com tecnologia, agilidade e muita qualidade!

Aqui no Time Eletronet, valorizamos pessoas que se envolvem, aprendem e fazem acontecer. Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, com desafios reais e oportunidades de crescimento, venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Descrição

Realizar e acompanhar atividades de implantação e manutenção nas estações da Eletronet, para garantir a entrega dos serviços com qualidade, dentro de cronogramas pré-estabelecidos, e assegurar disponibilidade de rede.

Atividades

  1. Realizar manutenções preventivas e corretivas em equipamentos de telecomunicações e em toda a infraestrutura dos sites.
  2. Executar atividades de instalação, ampliação, migração, ativação e desativação de equipamentos conforme projetos técnicos.
  3. Identificar falhas em máquinas de ar-condicionado e realizar pequenos reparos.
  4. Efetuar a troca de fusíveis, disjuntores e lâmpadas em painéis e quadros elétricos, quando necessário.
  5. Testar bancos de baterias, substituir elementos danificados e realizar a troca completa quando aplicável.
  6. Realizar testes em fibras ópticas com auxílio de OTDR e Power Meter.
  7. Executar vistorias em equipamentos, estações e redes ópticas para elaboração e atualização de projetos e apoio à Operação.
  8. Receber, interpretar e executar projetos de melhoria de rede encaminhados pela Engenharia.
  9. Atuar em manutenções e instalações programadas junto às contratadas e parceiras.
  10. Manter atualizado o controle de sobressalentes e materiais de reparo da Regional.
  11. Transportar pequenas quantidades de materiais para instalação e manutenção dos sites.
  12. Transportar, instalar e operar geradores de pequeno porte (bifásico ou trifásico até 8KVA 127V, 220V ou 380V), realizando abastecimento, acoplamento ao site e monitoramento da operação em conjunto com o CORE até o restabelecimento da energia comercial.
  13. Garantir a limpeza, organização e zeladoria dos sites.
  14. Realizar atividades em janelas noturnas, quando necessário.
  15. Conduzir veículo para deslocamento nas atividades diárias.

Requisitos

Ensino Técnico completo em Telecomunicações, Eletrônica ou em Eletrotécnica;

Conhecimento no pacote office;

Conhecimentos em Redes DWDM;

Conhecimento em Infraestrutura;

Disponibilidade para viagens;

CNH categoria B.

A Eletronet respeita a diversidade e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não realizamos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, buscando sempre um ambiente com perfis diversos.

title: Executivo Comercial
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Executivo Comercial em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a posição:

Na Falqon, transformamos dados em inteligência para negócios e governos. Buscamos um Executivo Comercial que vá além do perfil tradicional de vendas: alguém apaixonado por tecnologia e dados, com ambição para gerar impacto real, que consiga dialogar com líderes e decisores de igual para igual.

Não exigimos que você tenha histórico em vendas. O que buscamos é vivência prática em tecnologia, gestão ou inovação, ótima capacidade de comunicação e visão estratégica para traduzir soluções complexas em propostas de valor.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Gerar novas oportunidades de negócio de prospecção ativa, networking qualificado e participação em eventos estratégicos.
  • Conduzir conversas consultivas com nosso ICP (CIOs, Heads de Dados, Inovação e Tecnologia), conectando desafios de negócio a soluções em Analytics, IA, Cloud e Big Data.
  • Diagnosticar necessidades, propor soluções, negociar e acompanhar todo o ciclo de vendas até o fechamento.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times internos (operações, markering e especialistas técnicos) para elaborar propostas competitivas e entregas de alto valor;
  • Alimentar e organizar o CRM, assegurando previsibilidade e gestão do funil de vendas.
  • Contribuir com insights estratégicos de mercado para fortalecer o posicionamento da Falqon.

Perfil que Buscamos:

  • Apaixonado por tecnologia, IA e dados, sempre atualizado sobre tendências e inovações.
  • Boa comunicação: clareza para traduzir soluções técnicas em impacto de negócio.
  • Vivência prévia em cargos de tecnologia, festão, inovação ou operações (ter estado do outro lado da mesa é um grande diferencial).
  • Perfil analítico, curioso e resiliente, orientado a resultados.
  • Proatividade e autonomia para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e inovador.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em relacionamento com C-Level e contas estratégicas.
  • Histórico em negociação de soluções complexas ou vendas consultivas.
  • Conhecimento em metodogias de vendas como SPIN, Solution Selling ou Challenger.
  • Vivência em projetos de transformação digital, analytics ou inteligência artificial;

O que oferecemos:

  • Remuneração variável atrativa, alinhada à performance.
  • Possibilidade de crescimento acelerado na área comercial.
  • Ambiente dinâmico, inovador e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de atuar em projetos estratégicos de tecnologia e transformação digital.
  • Potencial de crescimento em um dos setores mais promissores da tecnologia.

Benefícios:

  • Salário compatível com o mercado.
  • Plano de saúde após 90 dias.
  • TotalPass.
  • Seguro de Vida.
  • Vale Alimentação e Vale Transporte

title: Assistente Comercial
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Assistente Comercial em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Construa o Futuro das Vendas Conosco: SDR/Closer para Banco de Talentos!

Você é apaixonado(a) por vendas e busca uma oportunidade para impactar o crescimento de uma empresa? Estamos em busca de profissionais SDR (Sales Development Representative) e Closers que desejam atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador.

Buscamos talentos com um perfil híbrido, capazes de transitar entre a prospecção qualificada e o fechamento de vendas, dominando cada etapa do funil. Se você tem experiência em atendimento ao cliente, qualificação de leads  e é craque em fechamento de vendas consultivas , essa é a sua chance!

Suas Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Transformar leads em oportunidades: Você será o primeiro contato com nossos potenciais clientes, respondendo rapidamente aos contatos gerados pelo marketing e qualificando-os para as próximas etapas.
  • Receber e gerenciar leads de diversas fontes: Será responsável pelo recebimento e qualificação de leads gerados por campanhas de tráfego pago, WhatsApp e telefone, garantindo um atendimento ágil e eficaz.
  • Ser um(a) verdadeiro(a) consultor(a): Adotará uma abordagem consultiva, mergulhando nas necessidades dos leads para oferecer as soluções mais adequadas e valiosas.
  • Dominar a arte da qualificação e identificação de necessidades: Utilizará técnicas avançadas, escuta ativa , para entender profundamente as dores e necessidades dos leads, visando municiar e facilitar a atuação dos especialistas dos demais serviços ofertados pela empresa (cross-selling), realizando follow-up ativo, acompanhando a presença em reuniões e entendendo os motivos de não compra para gerar novas oportunidades e solicitar indicações.
  • Gerenciar o processo de vendas com excelência: Manterá nosso CRM impecável, monitorando e atualizando todas as etapas do processo e funil de vendas, garantindo organização e assertividade.
  • Identificar o ouro nas oportunidades: Avaliará proativamente as oportunidades, identificando os leads com maior potencial de conversão e priorizando as ações.
  • Agilizar o caminho para o sucesso: Aplicará estratégias de fechamento eficazes para encurtar o ciclo de vendas e celebrar cada conquista.
  • Elaborar propostas vencedoras: Desenvolverá propostas comerciais claras, objetivas e personalizadas, alinhadas às necessidades dos clientes e que impulsionem o fechamento.
    Requisitos :
  • Experiência comprovada em vendas, com foco em prospecção e fechamento.
  • Habilidade excepcional em comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Capacidade de negociação e persuasão.
  • Orientação para resultados e paixão por superar metas.
  • Proatividade, resiliência e organização.

Diferenciais que Amamos:

  • Experiência com ferramentas de CRM
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de prospecção e cadências de whatsapp/e-mail/telefone.
  • Capacidade analítica para identificar gargalos em funis de vendas e propor melhorias.
  • Experiência na elaboração de propostas comerciais de alta complexidade.
  • Habilidade comprovada em identificar e aplicar oportunidades de cross-selling.

Se você se identifica com esse perfil e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que valoriza o desenvolvimento e o crescimento profissional, cadastre-se em nosso banco de talentos! Estamos ansiosos para conhecer o seu potencial e construir o futuro das vendas juntos.

Pronto(a) para o próximo desafio? Candidate-se e faça parte do nosso banco de talentos de SDRs e Closers!

title: Engenheiro de Dados
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de Dados em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados para integrar nosso time. Esse(a) profissional será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e manter soluções de dados que suportem análises, relatórios e aplicações estratégicas. Buscamos alguém com perfil colaborativo, visão analítica e que esteja sempre atento(a) às boas práticas de engenharia, qualidade e governança da informação.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e implementar pipelines de dados escaláveis (ETL/ELT).
  • Integrar diferentes fontes de dados, estruturadas e não estruturadas.
  • Garantir qualidade, segurança, consistência e disponibilidade dos dados.
  • Modelar dados para atender demandas de BI, analytics e ciência de dados.
  • Monitorar, otimizar e documentar os processos de ingestão e transformação.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com analistas, cientistas de dados e áreas de negócio para disponibilizar datasets confiáveis.
  • Acompanhar tendências tecnológicas e propor melhorias contínuas nas soluções de dados

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Linguagens: domínio de SQL e conhecimento em Javascript.
  • Bancos de Dados: experiência com bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle) e formatos de dados (CSV, JSON, Parquet, AVRO, ORC) e desejável conhecimento em bancos NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB).
  • Cloud: vivência em pelo menos uma das plataformas AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Big Data e Processamento: experiência com Spark, Hadoop ou Databricks.
  • ETL/Orquestração: ferramentas como Airflow, dbt, Talend ou similares.
  • Data Warehouse e Data Lake: Redshift, BigQuery, Snowflake, Synapse, S3, ADLS ou GCS.
  • Streaming (diferencial): Kafka, Kinesis ou Pub/Sub.
  • Versionamento e DevOps: Git, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform.

Perfil Desejado

  • Capacidade analítica e atenção a detalhes.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de trabalho em equipe.
  • Proatividade para identificar problemas e sugerir soluções.
  • Mentalidade voltada à melhoria contínua e inovação.

O que oferecemos:

  • Ambiente colaborativo, dinâmico e inovador.
  • Oportunidade de atuar em projetos estratégicos de Big Data, Analytics, Inteligência Artificial e Transformação Digital
  • Participação em um dos setores mais promissores da tecnologia, com grande potencial de desenvolvimento profissional.

Benefícios:

  • Salário compatível com o mercado.
  • Plano de saúde após 90 dias.
  • TotalPass.
  • Seguro de Vida.
  • Vale Alimentação e Vale Transporte

title: Analista contábil iii
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista contábil iii em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. NOSSO TEMPO SANGUE LARANJA #VEMSERATAK

Somos uma empresa legitimamente baiana. Uma história com um jeito único, que começou a ser escrita por Teobaldo, mas que evolui a cada dia graças à dedicação de Maria, Antônio, Ana, José, João e de tantos outros milhares de associados no dia a dia.

O Atakarejo segue rumo firme ao crescimento. E é assim, com muito trabalho, disciplina e determinação fazendo o simples muito bem feito, que a empresa continue rumo à sua visão de ser a melhor empresa de alimentos da Bahia e uma das 10 maiores do Brasil até 2025. Afinal, ter o Sangue Laranja é ter paixão por vencer.

Como é trabalhar aqui:

Quem trabalha no Atakarejo sabe que somos um tempo e possuímos um jeito único de ser. Trabalhamos com um propósito, temos uma grande visão, uma missão inspirada e valores verdadeiros que guiam nossas atitudes.

Esse nosso jeito único de ser é o que faz a diferença no dia a dia dos nossos colaboradores e clientes, e deve estar sempre em cada um de nós, é o sangue laranja que corre em nossas veias.Por isso estamos sempre em busca de novos talentos orientados a fazer a diferença conosco.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:
  • Executar as atividades inerentes ao fechamento contábil;
  • Executar as atividades internas ao controle patrimonial da empresa, garantindo o lançamento das aquisições baixa, transferências e demais eventos vinculados ao ativo imobilizado;
  • Conciliar a movimentação das contas patrimoniais, analisando o livro razão da movimentação das contas;
  • Fazer a análise das variações das contas patrimoniais e de resultados;
  • Realizar os lançamentos e análises de provisão e reversão;
  • Integrar e conciliar os arquivos da folha de pagamento;
  • Confeccionar as declarações federais;
  • Atender demandas inerentes e auditoria externa;
  • Manter contato frequente com todos os setores da empresa.
Qualificações possíveis:
  • Conhecimento no pacote office avançado;
  • Experiência com as atividades descritas acima;
  • Sólido conhecimento contábil e de conciliação de contas;
  • Conhecimento na legislação tributária federal.
